library_preparation_preflight.summary: No extra setup is needed. The scaffold can cover the library's reflection and resource surface without a Couchbase server, and no Couchbase Docker image is allow-listed.
risks: I did not run the library or check its dependency tree. The decision rests on the repo contents plus general knowledge of the client.

Real cluster, bucket and query operations need a Couchbase Server. No Couchbase image is under allowed-docker-images (only metrics-micrometer and tracing-micrometer-observation exist for com.couchbase.client), and adding one is heavy. Coverage will probably come from the offline surface instead: ClusterEnvironment/ClusterOptions building, JSON codecs and serializers, and Cluster.connect against an unreachable host with short timeouts.

The sibling tests metrics-micrometer and tracing-micrometer-observation (both 3.11.3) already use the same client family without Docker. Their micrometer dependencies and test layout are a reference for how the generated tests should be written.
